title: Telemetry-first hardware profile curation and automated pin recommender
creator: Asha Patel
description: Establish a telemetry-driven pipeline to generate hardware-specific performance profiles for A100/H100/L40S/MI300, surface confidence-scored pin recommendations for model versions, and publish stable profiles to the model catalog. The goal is to replace heuristic/manual profile curation with a metrics-first signal that improves pin quality and accelerates safe rollouts across Dedicated and Private deployments.
context: We currently rely on static benchmark artifacts and ad-hoc engineer validation when deciding model pins per GPU SKU. That process is slow, error-prone, and doesn't capture live production characteristics (KV hit rate, batching distributions, tail latency under real traffic). Several outages and regressions were traced to overly broad pins that didn't reflect regional device variance. This ticket builds an automated curation path driven by production telemetry plus controlled lab runs to produce publishable profiles and actionable pin recommendations.
goals: Ingest per-request and per-batch telemetry (latency p50/p90/p95/p99, token/sec, kv hit rate, cold-start penalty, memory pressure) tagged by model, model_version, device_sku (A100/H100/L40S/MI300), and region
Compute an ensemble performance score and stability/confidence metric per model_version x device_sku
Expose a single-click 'Recommend Pin' action in the console that writes a pin proposal with rationale and rollback criteria
Publish a vetted performance profile object to the model catalog (runtime-1.22) for use by smart routing and fallback policies
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline consumes telemetry from both hosted runtime and dedicated pools for at least three production tenants (sampling enabled) and lab-run synthetic traces
Score and confidence computation validated against historical regressions (replay validation shows the recommender would have avoided at least two past mis-pins), documented in the PRD
Console UI surfaces recommended pin with predicted latency delta, expected cost delta, and a suggested rollback threshold (e.g., 15% p95 increase)

Profile publishing writes a JSON schema validated artifact to the catalog with fields: device_sku, model_version, p50/p95/p99 latencies, kv_cache_behavior, recommended_quant_profiles, confidence_score, provenance
End-to-end tests: CI job that validates a published profile against a cross-device stability test-suite (lab runs) and rejects profiles with confidence < 0.7
Documentation: onboarding playbook, operator runbook, and a postmortem checklist are added to Confluence
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): run pipeline in read-only mode for 2 weeks; surface recommendations to SRE and Runtime Owners for A100 only
Phase 2: enable recommend action (manual approve) for A100 and H100 in staging; validate with synthetic replay jobs
Phase 3: add L40S and MI300 signals; run auto-check CI that prevents publish if confidence < 0.7
Phase 4: enable 'auto-propose' drafts for all SKUs and wire into release playbook; auto-revert policy enabled in console (rollback if p95 exceeds suggested threshold for X minutes)
Rollbacks: documented rollback playbook and immediate unpin shortcut in Console
test_plan: Unit tests for scoring functions and aggregation windows
Integration test that replays recorded production traces through scoring pipeline and asserts stable ranking across repeated runs
Lab validation job that runs model variants on canonical sequences across A100/H100/L40S/MI300 and produces expected p95 envelope
Chaos test: simulate KV cache thrashing and confirm confidence score reflects instability
Canary verification scripts: compare runtime traces pre/post pin and ensure no regressions beyond thresholds
updates: 2025-02-19: Kickoff meeting with Runtime, Observability, and Product. Agreed telemetry schema and sampling budget (0.5% full traces + telemetry aggregates). Action: Observability to add device_sku in trace tags (Olivier assigned).

2025-02-24: Prototype scoring prototype merged (github.com/redwood/runtime/pulls/1213). Scoring uses weighted p95 + kv_stability + cold_start_factor to compute confidence. Initial weights: p95(0.5), kv_stability(0.3), cold_start(0.2).
2025-02-28: Decided to require >=0.7 confidence to auto-publish lab-profile; manual recommend allowed down to 0.6. Rationale documented in confluence: /spaces/ONB/pages/telemetry-recommender.
2025-03-03: Console UX mock (DES-214) reviewed by Morgan Ruiz; landed minor copy changes. PR for UI component opened: github.com/redwood/console/pulls/459.

2025-03-05: Integration job for replay validation failing intermittently due to misaligned trace timestamps from Dedicated pools. Workaround: Observability will normalize timestamps in ETL. Assigned to Priya Shah.
notes: Edge case: MI300 remote clusters report different mem pressure metrics; mapping layer will normalize similar fields to 'mem_high' boolean for scoring
We should keep a historical delta window (30d) for each model_version x device_sku to detect slow-degrading regressions separate from immediate anomalies
Plan to surface provenance: lab-run id + production-sample-window id in the published profile
Follow-up: evaluate adding model-input-complexity as a feature in scoring (token length, embedding size)
